title: Render collapsible shopping list header area
description: Add the reusable header view and integrate it into the shopping-list detail screen above progress and aisle sections with scene-scoped collapse persistence.
acceptance_criteria: A new header view renders extracted markdown content with the specified line handling, disclosure label, and typography.
`ShoppingListDetailView` shows the header area only when extraction returns content and places it above the progress header.
Collapse state uses the per-file `@SceneStorage` key from the spec and defaults to expanded.

handoff_summary.completed: New ShoppingListHeaderView renders HeaderContent with per-file @SceneStorage collapse persistence (defaulting to expanded), a disclosure toggle labeled with firstHeading ?? "Notes", and line-by-line markdown rendering that skips the first ## heading. ShoppingListDetailView now calls ShoppingListHeaderExtractor.extract(from: list.text) and shows the header section conditionally above the progress row. Added ShoppingListHeaderView.swift to the Xcode project (PBXBuildFile, PBXFileReference, group, and Sources build phase). Type-check of ShoppingListHeaderView + ShoppingListHeaderExtractor passed cleanly.
handoff_summary.risks: The ShoppingListDetailView calls ShoppingListHeaderExtractor.extract on every view update; this is a pure parsing call on a short string and should be negligible, but could be memoized if performance becomes a concern.
handoff_summary.next_action: Hand off to tester agent for unit/UI test coverage of ShoppingListHeaderView collapse behaviour and ShoppingListDetailView header integration.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: No known conflicts; only ShoppingListDetailView.swift and the new ShoppingListHeaderView.swift were touched.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: Used @SceneStorage with dynamic init (_isExpanded = SceneStorage(wrappedValue: true, storageKey)) to support per-file persistence without static key literals. Storage key format: "shoppingList.header.expanded.\(url.lastPathComponent)". Disclosure label falls back to "Notes" when firstHeading is nil. The first ## heading line is excluded from body rendering since it is already shown as the disclosure label.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: Tester should verify: (1) collapse/expand toggle persists across navigation; (2) header section absent when extraction returns nil; (3) firstHeading nil falls back to "Notes" label; (4) second ## heading in body renders with semibold subheadline styling.
handoff_summary.known_limitations: SwiftUI Text(AttributedString(markdown:)) supports inline formatting only — block-level markdown (headings, lists) is not rendered with special styling unless handled by lineView logic.

conflict_risks: No known conflicts; only ShoppingListDetailView.swift and the new ShoppingListHeaderView.swift were touched.

execution_history.summary: Created ShoppingListHeaderView.swift and updated ShoppingListDetailView.swift to render a collapsible header area above the progress section when shopping list markdown contains header content.
